query: INSERT INTO idempotency_keys (account_id, principal, key, request_sha256, status, body, created_at) VALUES ($1, $2, $3, $4, $5, $6, $7) ON CONFLICT (account_id, principal, key) DO UPDATE SET request_sha256 = EXCLUDED.request_sha256, status = EXCLUDED.status, body = EXCLUDED.body, created_at = EXCLUDED.created_at WHERE idempotency_keys.created_at < $8
